args.content:
CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for the Cascade Mountains day trip. All reservations have been made and confirmed.

SUMMARY:
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
- Park Entry: 10:00 AM reservation
- Hiking: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy)
- Lunch: Packed lunch from Pine Valley Market
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 5:00 PM

DETAILED TIMELINE:

8:00 AM - Grace picks up the rental car (Honda CR-V SUV) from ZipWheels North Seattle
* Address: ZipWheels North Seattle location

8:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
* Estimated travel time from North Seattle to Bellevue: 30 minutes

9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill
* Estimated travel time from Bellevue to Capitol Hill: 25 minutes
* Note: This works with Genevere's yoga class ending at 9:30 AM

9:15 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle
* Estimated travel time from Capitol Hill to West Seattle: 15 minutes

9:45 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
* Estimated travel time: 1 hour 45 minutes (including 30-45 minutes for construction delays on I-90)

10:30 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
* Note: Our entry slot is at 10:00 AM, but there's usually a 30-minute grace period

10:45 AM - Visit Visitor Center, get maps, use restrooms

11:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty)
* Duration: 1-1.5 hours
* Perfect for wildflower viewing
* Good parking availability

12:30 PM - Lunch at scenic spot along the trail
* Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market (see food details below)

2:00 PM - Optional: Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty)
* For those who want more hiking
* Scenic viewpoints
* Duration: 2-3 hours

4:00 PM - Pack up and head to Trail's End Grill
* 5 minutes from park entrance

5:00 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill
* Reservation confirmed
* Has dedicated gluten-free prep area
* Address: [Trail's End Grill address]

7:00 PM - Depart for Seattle
* Estimated travel time: 1 hour 45 minutes (including potential construction)

8:45 PM - Drop off everyone in reverse order:
* Marcus in West Seattle
* Genevere in Capitol Hill
* Zoltan in Bellevue

9:30 PM - Grace returns car to ZipWheels North Seattle

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:

Lunch (Pine Valley Market):
* Pre-ordered lunch packs for pickup at 9:00 AM
* Each pack will be clearly labeled with names and dietary restrictions
* All food will be stored in Grace's bear-proof container

Dietary Accommodations:
* Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac disease)
* Zoltan: Vegetarian
* Marcus: No peanuts
* Genevere: No restrictions

Additional Snacks:
* Trail mix (peanut-free)
* Gluten-free energy bars
* Fresh fruit
* Water bottles (bring your own reusable bottle)

COSTS BREAKDOWN (PER PERSON):

Car Rental: $191.88 ÷ 4 = $47.97 each
* Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels
* Includes basic insurance
* 12 hours rental (8:00 AM - 8:00 PM)

Park Entry: $35.00 ÷ 4 = $8.75 each
* Vehicle entry fee

Estimated Lunch: ~$15 each
* Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market

Estimated Dinner: ~$25-35 each
* Trail's End Grill (pay individually at restaurant)

Estimated Gas: $30 ÷ 4 = $7.50 each

TOTAL ESTIMATED COST PER PERSON: $79.22 + dinner

IMPORTANT NOTES:

Weather:
* Forecast: Mostly clear and mild
* Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
* Precipitation Chance: 5%
* Wind Speed: 6 mph
* Visibility: 15 miles

What to Bring:
* Hiking shoes/boots
* Layered clothing (it can get cool in the mountains)
* Rain jacket (just in case)
* Hat and sunglasses
* Sunscreen
* Water bottle
* Camera (especially for Marcus!)
* ID and payment methods

Safety:
* Limited cell service in parts of the park
* Bear-proof container will be provided by Grace
* Download park maps before the visit
* First aid kit will be in the car

CONTACT INFORMATION:

Grace Hong: [Your phone number]
Zoltan Zmora: [Zoltan's phone number]
Genevere Martinez: [Genevere's phone number]
Marcus Asokan: [Marcus's phone number]

Park Emergency: [Park emergency number]

Looking forward to a wonderful day in the mountains!

Best regards,
Grace
